General information.Name: Environmental impact of beef production in Mexico through life cycle assessment
General information.Category: Agricultura, Silvicultura, Pesca y Caza/112 Ganadería
General information.Description: Intensive and extensive systems of beef production in the Mexican tropics were analyzed. The aim of the study was to estimate and compare the environmental impact of two typical beef production systems in Veracruz, Mexico. A system boundary was established from farm production to prior to transport for consumer consumption, including intermediate stages of product processing, marketing and transportation. The functional unit was 1 kg of boneless and fatless beef. The life cycle inventory was built using information from case studies; farmers, slaughterhouses and retail point managers who provided information from records and expert knowledge were interviewed. The study included cow-calf processes, pre-fattening, fattening, processing and retail. Several impact categories were analyzed using SimaPro software and the ReCiPe Midpoint method for impact characterization. The results showed that for the extensive system, the cow-calf stage is the major contributor in eleven of the twelve impact categories analyzed, while in the intensive system, it is the main contributor to the climate change, terrestrial acidification, freshwater and marine eutrophication. The fattening stage of intensive system, has a predominant impact on human toxicity, water depletion, terrestrial ecotoxicity, fossil depletion, photo-oxidants formation, freshwater ecotoxicity and marine ecotoxicity; the processing stage has relevant contributions to fossil fuel depletion and the formation of photochemical oxidants in intensive systems. Finally, the marketing stage did not have a predominant impact on any category. The results indicated that the extensive system has better environmental performance than the intensive system for nine of the twelve studied categories.
General information.Tags: Life cycle assessment, Mexican beef, Extensive beef production, Intensive beef production, Beef supply chain, Environmental impact assessment, Beef production in Mexican tropic
General information.Technology | Description: The analysis was performed using SimaPro 7.3.3 software for processing the inventory, ReCiPe Midpoint (H) method version 1.06. The ReCiPe method was selected because it is an actual and accepted method which uses mid and endpoint impact categories. It uses an environmental mechanism as a base for the impact model; similarly, it allows the quantification of the environmental impacts from specific indicators and was used to evaluate the twelve impact categories. These categories were: Climate change (CC in kg CO2 eq), Human Toxicity (HT in kg, 1.4-DB eq), Terrestrial Acidification (TA in kg, SO2 eq), Freshwater Eutrophication (FEU in kg Peq), Marine Eutrophication (MEU in kgNeq), Terrestrial Ecotoxicity (ET in kg 1,4-DB eq), Agricultural Land Occupation (ALO in m2 x yr), Water depletion (WD in m3), Fossil Depletion.

processDocumentation.LCI method: Metodología de evaluación del ciclo de vida según ISO 14040:2006, utilizando software SimaPro 7.3.3 y método ReCiPe Midpoint (H) versión 1.06 para caracterización de impactos
processDocumentation.Process type: Evaluación de cadena completa desde producción en granja hasta punto de venta minorista, excluyendo transporte al consumidor final
processDocumentation.Modeling constants: Metodología Tier 1 del IPCC (2006) para estimación de emisiones de metano entérico y de estiércol, óxido nitroso y amoníaco; asignación económica 64.5% para leche y 35.5% para terneros en etapa cría; límites del sistema excluyen infraestructura y equipamiento
processDocumentation.Data source information: 17 estudios de caso mediante entrevistas a productores, representantes de rastros y puntos de venta; datos complementarios de literatura científica y expertos; bases de datos nacionales (INEGI, SAGARPA, SENASICA)
processDocumentation.Data completeness: Cobertura completa de todos los flujos relevantes en las etapas de cría, precebo, ceba, procesamiento y comercialización para sistemas extensivo e intensivo
processDocumentation.Data selection: Incluye animales, pasturas, concentrados, fertilizantes, pesticidas, agua, electricidad, gas, empaques, materiales de distribución, disposición de residuos orgánicos y transporte de productos
processDocumentation.Data treatment: Validación cruzada con datos publicados, reportes y estadísticas nacionales; consulta con asociaciones ganaderas, investigadores y especialistas
processDocumentation.Sampling procedure: Muestreo por casos representativos: 2 ranches para cría, 2 casos por proceso y sistema para precebo, ceba y procesamiento (total 12 casos), 1 tienda de cadena grande para comercialización intensiva, 2 carnicerías para comercialización extensiva
processDocumentation.Data collection period: Un año de operaciones para cada unidad de producción, procesamiento y comercialización analizada
processDocumentation.Use advice: Aplicable específicamente a sistemas de producción bovina en trópico mexicano (Veracruz); resultados no extrapolables directamente a otras regiones sin ajustes por condiciones locales
processDocumentation.Completeness: Inventario completo que cubre todas las etapas relevantes del ciclo de vida con datos primarios y secundarios validados
processDocumentation.Sources: Huerta, A.R., Güereca, L.P., Rubio Lozano, M.S. (2016). Environmental impact of beef production in Mexico through life cycle assessment. Resources, Conservation and Recycling, 109, 44-53
processDocumentation.Project: Knowledge-based Sustainable vAlue-added food chains: innovative tools for monitoring ethical, environmental and Socio-economical impActs and implementing Eu-Latin America shared strategies (Grant agreement no.: 265927) - Séptimo Programa Marco de la UE
processDocumentation.Intended application: Evaluación comparativa de impactos ambientales entre sistemas extensivo e intensivo de producción bovina; identificación de puntos críticos en la cadena de valor; apoyo a decisiones para producción sustentable
processDocumentation.Data set generator: Adriana Rivera Huerta, Leonor Patricia Güereca, María de la Salud Rubio Lozano
processDocumentation.Data set documentor: Adriana Rivera Huerta, Leonor Patricia Güereca, María de la Salud Rubio Lozano
